intro.text: Placeholder: the crystals ring when the drill stops. Then, from the far wall of the hollow, something knocks back: three times, patient.

options.text: Placeholder: kill the lamps and wait it out.

answer.text: Placeholder: the knocking stops. When the lamps come back on, a row of cut crystals has been set out on the ledge by the pool.

wall.text: Placeholder: the far wall answers by coming in. Crystal and rock slam into the hull before the hollow goes still.

quiet.text: Placeholder: you wait in the dark for a long time. Nothing knocks again. Far above, the follower keeps coming.
